# 0.6.0 — Stablecoin and network selection

- Select USDT or USDC first, then an eligible payment network, in classic and block checkout.
- Supports 11 service-enabled combinations across TRON, Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Polygon, Solana and Base. TRON supports USDT only.
- Base USDT is bridged; BNB USDC is Binance-Peg. Explicit route labels remain.
- Active service routes, plugin settings and merchant wallets still control availability. Upgrades retain USDT-only defaults.
- Refresh-safe selection, server-side route validation, embedded official brand assets and updated Solana artwork.
- Existing orders, credentials and signed payment verification are preserved.

Install the ZIP asset through WordPress Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin. Verify its SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS.txt.
